verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline and CTA as the clear focal points, but it puts the SOLSTICE wordmark under the headline, so the reading order is wrong. Its flavour pills are jammed edge to edge, the subtitle is shrunk to an illegible two-line scrap beside them, and the CTA nearly touches the right edge. B is worse: the flavour pills are blown up bigger and bolder than the Shop Flavours CTA, so they look like competing buttons. The CTA is buried under the headline, the SOLSTICE logo floats on its own between groups, and the subtitle sits off to one side, so the hierarchy breaks down.
